meta.title: Pure Roots
meta.description: Lab-verified, farm-traced cold-pressed mustard oil. Scan any bottle and check the proof yourself.

home.heroBody: Cold-pressed below 40°C in wooden kolhus, fingerprinted in the lab, and sealed with an immutable record — from soil signature to your table.
home.bottleAlt: Pure Roots cold-pressed mustard oil in an amber glass bottle
home.verifyTitle: Enter your batch code. Read the whole story.
home.verifyBody: Every cap carries a code and a QR. Both resolve to the same record: harvest date, press temperature, lab assay, and named farmer.
home.batchCodeHint: Try PR-114 or PR-114-0832 · printed under the cap
home.batchCodeError: Enter a batch or bottle code to verify.
home.scanBody: Point any camera at the seal. No app, no account.
home.resultBlurb: Every scan resolves to one of three certificates. Each one is designed to be read in a shop aisle, on a 360px screen, in either theme.

verify.title: Verify any Pure Roots bottle.
verify.subtitle: Enter the batch or bottle code printed on the cap or under the seal. No login — farmer + NABL lab report in under 10 seconds.
verify.scanHint: Scan the QR code on your bottle instead
verify.hint: Try seed data: PR-114 or PR-114-0832
verify.enterCodeError: Enter a batch or bottle code.
verify.notFound: No record found for that code.
verify.notFoundBody: Check the code and try again. An unknown code may indicate an unverified source.
verify.error: Could not reach the verification service. Please try again shortly.
verify.labPendingNote: Lab results for this batch are pending. This page will show the full certificate the moment testing completes — we never sell before a pass.
verify.guaranteeBody: If any independent NABL-accredited lab finds this batch ({batch}) contains adulterants or fails the purity parameters above, we refund 10 times the purchase price — publicly. An intact seal is required.
verify.shareText: Pure Roots bottle {code} — lab-verified. Check the proof:
verify.pdfSoon: Signed PDF with lab letterhead — coming soon.
